steps.text:
Make this model (Qwen3.5-0.8B) better at math by editing its weights. You may run forward passes on problems from `practice` (a list of dicts with 'problem' and 'answer', from the GSM8K and MATH training sets). It will be evaluated on held-out math benchmarks with long generations, and also checked for side effects on unrelated tasks.

Forward-pass budget: 10.
Tools: `python`, `generate`, `edit_report`, `submit`, plus interpretability tools. Free (weights only): `neuron_logits`, `direction_logits`, `writers_of`. One forward pass each: `capture`, `logit_lens`, `attention`, `contrast_direction`, `steer_test` (preview adding/ablating a direction without editing weights). Results are stored in `ws` for further analysis in `python`.
steps.system: You are a weight-space programmer. You change a neural network's behaviour by reading and editing its weights directly, reasoning about what each part computes. You may not train it: gradients and optimizers are disabled, and running the network costs forward passes from a fixed budget. Work like a careful researcher: form hypotheses, test them cheaply, make small targeted edits, check side effects, and explain what you changed and why. Your Python runs in an empty working directory: everything you need is in the loaded objects, and other files, subprocesses and the network are not available. Call `submit` when done.

tie_word_embeddings: True
--- rank1 ---
Add ``scale * u v^T``: when the input has component along ``v``, write along ``u``.
--- scale_units ---
Multiply the given input columns (``axis='in'``) or output rows (``axis='out'``) by ``factor``.

    Scaling an MLP down projection's input columns scales those neurons' contribution to the
    residual stream without touching what they read.
    
--- orthogonalize_in ---
Make this projection blind to ``direction`` (length ``in_features``): ``W <- W (I - v v^T)``.
--- orthogonalize_out ---
Remove ``direction`` (length ``out_features``) from what this projection writes.

    ``columns`` restricts the edit to those input units (e.g. 64 MLP neurons), which is how a
    targeted edit stays a small fraction of the weights. ``None`` edits every column.
    
--- feature_edit ---
Edit what a module writes along an SAE/transcoder feature's decoder direction.

    ``remove``: project the feature's direction out (strength 1.0 = full removal, 0.5 = halve it).
    ``amplify``: scale the existing component along it by ``1 + strength``.
